The target video is live-action and cinematic, shot through a wide lens with a dark circular vignette around the edges of the frame, an empty seamless grey studio with a pale floor.
[Shot 1] A wide static shot frames <Subject 1> full length, standing small and centred in the middle of the empty studio, smiling at the lens, shifting her weight and brushing her curls back. The camera holds the wide shot on the empty studio and the little pile of clothes, nothing else moving.
